metadata.goal: Convert archived OpenSpec change add-xnl-parser into Codument archive format.

phase.name: Implementation
phase.goal: Implementation tasks converted from OpenSpec checklist.

task.name: Define public parse API and AST/type definitions (aligning with XNL content types).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Define public parse API and AST/type definitions (aligning with XNL content types).

task.name: Implement parsing of nodes and bodies for `{>`, `[>`, `{[>`, `(>`, and `>` blocks with structural validation.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Implement parsing of nodes and bodies for `{>`, `[>`, `{[>`, `(>`, and `>` blocks with structural validation.

task.name: Parse attribute value forms `{ ... }`, `[ ... ]`, `( ... )`, raw blocks, and plain scalars into typed values.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Parse attribute value forms `{ ... }`, `[ ... ]`, `( ... )`, raw blocks, and plain scalars into typed values.

task.name: Preserve `(>` raw code content verbatim while still enforcing tag pairing.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Preserve `(>` raw code content verbatim while still enforcing tag pairing.

task.name: Export package entry points and build outputs usable in Node and browser environments with generated `.d.ts`.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Export package entry points and build outputs usable in Node and browser environments with generated `.d.ts`.

task.name: Add unit tests covering successful parses, error conditions (mismatched tags, duplicate child names, invalid mixes), and attribute parsing.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Add unit tests covering successful parses, error conditions (mismatched tags, duplicate child names, invalid mixes), and attribute parsing.

task.name: Document the parser API and expected error semantics for initial consumers.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Document the parser API and expected error semantics for initial consumers.
